name: Chemistry AP: Molvane
subtitle: Chemistry AP Mocks & FRQs
shortDescription: Practice AP Chemistry with original questions, worked solutions, free-response sets and timed mock exams.
longDescription:
Practice AP Chemistry with original questions, worked solutions, free-response sets and timed mock exams.

### What is inside
Over 200 multiple-choice questions, each with a full worked solution and a reason why every wrong choice is wrong. Sixteen original free-response questions with point-by-point rubrics. Short topic notes with common traps and links to the official course description and open textbooks.

### Study your way
Quick and full timed mocks, a daily practice round, and a rough 1 to 5 estimate that is clearly labelled as an estimate. Text size controls on every screen. No account needed, and it works offline.

AP is a registered trademark of the College Board, which is not affiliated with this app.
